displayName: Niche 2: Bị sỉ nhục / Trả đũa / Công lý
description: Urban thriller justice built around public humiliation, viral evidence, staged accusations, lawsuit pressure, audit trail, public apology, karma payoff, and status reversal. The engine is documented public revenge with paper trails, security footage, recordings, and institutional accountability — not romance, not corporate-power leverage, not family inheritance.
emotionalAxis: public humiliation wound, urban justice pressure, paper-trail evidence reveal, delayed karma, public apology refusal, status reversal in the same room she was shamed in

chapterArcDefaults.hookStyle: public disrespect or staged accusation in a venue with witnesses, demanding documented payoff

humiliationPacing: she is mocked in public by someone gatekeeping a venue, queue, or service desk
her status markers are misjudged and used as proof she does not belong
witnesses choose the side with the louder voice and refuse to step in
a viral clip or staged receipt spreads before context catches up
a manager or authority figure backs the humiliator on camera
her professional credentials are publicly questioned without evidence
a false witness or fabricated complaint locks her out of a room she earned
the truth is intentionally delayed so the humiliation can compound
the humiliator brags privately, captured on a recording she keeps
revengeActivation: clean documentary evidence (footage, contracts, audit logs) lands in the same public space
status reversal happens in the same room she was shamed in, with the same audience
a lawsuit, audit, or licensing review forces accountability with paperwork
the people who mocked her face concrete consequences (fired, license suspended, contract pulled)
she refuses a cheap private apology and demands it where the harm happened
the humiliator's recording or message proves intent, not misunderstanding
press conference or all-hands becomes the reveal stage, not a private settlement
she protects another wrongly accused person before claiming her own dignity
the policy or rule that allowed the humiliation gets rewritten on the record
dignityRecoveryTiming: strong late reveal in the same public venue, with documented receipts and a moral turn — never a private hush-money settlement

belongsHere: public humiliation wound that demands documented public payoff
